account-locked: I-akhawunti ivalelwe okwesikhatshana ngenxa yemizamo yokungena eminengi eyehlulekileyo. Sicela uzame futhi ngemva kwesikhathi.
cloud-panel-not-allowed: I-Cloud Panel ngeka-SuperAdmin kuphela, kudomeni ye-Cloud Panel.
cloud-settings-desc: Nge-WeKan ku-Weddy, i-Cloud Panel isebenzela amadomeni amanengi e-WeKan kusuka kuseva eyodwa, ngalinye lilemininingwane yalo. Kudomeni ye-Cloud Panel, u-SuperAdmin uphatha amadomeni le-CloudFlare.
cloudflare-api-key-desc: Ngekhiye ye-CloudFlare API, idomeni elizone yalo isekhawuntini yakho ye-CloudFlare lithola irekhodi le-DNS elidlula nge-proxy kanye lesitifiketi se-CloudFlare Origin. Amanye amadomeni athola isitifiketi se-Let's Encrypt. Ikhiye igcinwa kuseva njalo kayisoze iphinde itshengiswe.
cloudflare-api-key-not-set: Kakulakhiye ye-CloudFlare API egciniweyo: idomeni ngalinye lithola isitifiketi se-Let's Encrypt.
